name: @orchestrum/desktop
description: Desktop operator shell for Orchestrum. Preview until signing and hardening are enabled.
author: Murat Ergin

scripts.dist: npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
